mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hyperphosphatemia) that impair renal function and increase eplerenone levels, while both drugs increase hyperkalemia risk through aldosterone antagonism and renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and magnesium frequently; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet infusion; consider eplerenone dose reduction or discontinuation if renal function declines; supplement magnesium as needed.
